example_prompt: Show the attempts and last HTTP status of Cartflox webhook delivery cmu8d4e5f0003abc.

id.description: Webhook delivery identifier. Passed as a path parameter.

last_status_code.description: HTTP status of the last attempt.

response_ms.description: Duration of the last attempt, in milliseconds.

livemode.description: `true` for a production object, `false` for a test object: created with a test key, or in a workspace not switched live yet. Verify webhook signatures with the secret key of the same mode.

error_schema.description: Error body. `code` is present on transfer endpoints.

gotchas: max_attempts is 10: up to 10 attempts in total over about 72 hours. next_attempt_at is the next automatic attempt (null otherwise); last_status_code, last_error and response_ms describe the last attempt.
transaction_id is set for payment events, transfer_id for transfer events.
Deliveries are split by mode: a test key sees only test deliveries, a production key only production ones; use the key of the delivery's mode.

Errors are an HTTP 4xx/5xx status with a JSON body { "error": "<message>" }. Transfer endpoints add a machine-readable code, and so do some other refusals (code test_mode on payment links, rate_limited on webhook resends). A 401 says Missing API key or Invalid API Key.
